_readme: Camera calibrations. ground.image: near-left, near-right, far-right, far-left corners of a rectangle on the road, picked at frame_size. width_m/length_m: that rectangle in metres; scale_verified=false means nobody measured it, so absolute metres and speeds are nominal (they cancel out of a wait only when the booth is in view). Lanes: across/along are fractions of the rectangle; along may run past [0,1]. booth_distance_m: metres from the strip's booth-end row to the inspection booth, null = not measured (no wait is produced, only queue and speed). cbp_lane: null until someone confirms which CBP lane type the strip is. mask: x,y,w,h overlays (clock, logos, QR codes, signs that hide the road). Check any change with `camera snapshot`. clock: the burned-in date/time box; a stream whose clock stops changing for 20 s is reported frozen. booth_distance_uncertainty_m / booth_distance_verified: a distance estimated from a map carries its +/- and verified=false; the wait's range widens by it and the viewer marks the minutes approximate.

pdn-north.title: Paso del Norte (Norte)
pdn-north.notes: Looks north up the bridge from the Juarez end; the US booths are past the far end, out of view. lane-1..lane-3 (left to right) split the carriageway between the yellow left curb and the white bollard line into equal thirds (width assumed 3 x 3.5 m). They are read separately because they queue separately: at 03:16 local on 2026-10-19 only the middle lane was queued. The Feliz Viaje sign hides the road behind it and is masked. lane-4 runs between the white bollards and the orange barrels, lane-5 between the barrels and the right curb; their edges were mapped through this rectangle's homography on a daylight frame (bollards at 1.00 of the width at every depth, curb 1.79-1.89, barrels tapering 1.45 to 1.25 where they end). At 08:40 local on 2026-10-19 the queue had moved from lanes 1-3 to these two. Booth distance (2026-10-22, Google satellite, map scale bar): from the Feliz Viaje gantry at about 31.7463,-106.4866 north along the bridge to the CBP primary-booth canopy at about 31.7500,-106.4868: ~410 m, +/-30 m. The strips do not end at the gantry: they run on under and past the sign. In a 2026-10-22 snapshot the gantry posts reach the road at about image y 405-420, which this calibration puts ~45 m (nominal; the scale is unverified) short of the strips' booth-end row, so booth_distance_m from that row is 410 - 45 = ~365 m, +/-35 m (map, post feet and scale). The gantry was placed from the layout (the parking lot west of the bridge appears beside the middle of the lanes); Street View has no imagery on the bridge deck to confirm it.

lerdo-north.title: Lerdo (Norte)
lerdo-north.notes: Looks north along the Lerdo-Stanton bridge from the Juarez end. right-roadway is the straight stretch between the bollard line and the orange right curb, with the northbound arrow; width assumed two lanes (7 m). CBP names this port 'Stanton DCL', but which lane type the strip is has not been confirmed. Below y=380 the roadway curves left toward the camera and is not covered by the straight strip. Booth distance (2026-10-22, Google satellite): from the overpass over Av. Heroico Colegio Militar, visible at the top of this camera's picture, at about 31.7474,-106.4824, along the bridge to the Stanton commuter-lane booth canopy at about 31.7502,-106.4833; ~335 m, +/-35 m. Not yet corrected to the strip's booth-end row: that row sits short of the far gantry at the top of the picture by a gap this calibration cannot measure (the road climbs there, so the flat-road warp does not hold past the strip), so 335 m is likely an under-estimate.

pdn-south-street.title: Paso del Norte (Sur)
pdn-south-street.notes: Looks south down the Juarez street that feeds the Paso del Norte bridge; the queue faces the camera and drives toward it, so the booth end is the near end and the bridge is behind the camera. No lane markings (cobblestone); the two strips follow the two queue columns seen at 04:56 local on 2026-10-19, left along the barrier fence. Vendors walk between the columns. Width assumed ~9 m. Booth distance (2026-10-22, Google satellite): the camera is placed at the north end of this street near the foot of the bridge (~31.7457,-106.4865), not confirmed; from there up Av. Benito Juarez and across the bridge to the CBP primary booths at about 31.7500,-106.4868: ~480 m, +/-70 m. That is from the camera; the strips' booth-end row is in front of it, ~30 m (nominal) by the camera position this calibration implies (height ~14 m; square pixels and a centred image assumed), so booth_distance_m is ~510 m, +/-75 m.

bota-south-approach.title: Córdova - Américas (Sur)
bota-south-approach.notes: Looks south down the approach road to the Bridge of the Americas, with the bridge behind the camera. The queue in the left carriageway drives toward the camera: the reader's signed speed was negative in all 15 rounds from 03:16 to 07:56 local on 2026-10-19 with the booth set at the far end, so it is set at the near end. (Red lights seen on these cars at night had suggested the opposite; the measurement overruled that.) Two lanes, width assumed 7 m. The right carriageway carries other traffic and is not calibrated. BOTA is not administered by FPFCH (on-screen banner). Booth distance (2026-10-22, Google satellite): the camera is placed on Av. de las Americas south of the Mexican plaza (~31.7616,-106.4519) from the flag monument and visitor-centre sign on its right, not confirmed; from there north across the bridge to the CBP primary booths at about 31.7669,-106.4511: ~600 m, +/-70 m. That is from the camera; the strips' booth-end row is in front of it, ~17 m (nominal) by the camera position this calibration implies (height ~11 m; square pixels and a centred image assumed), so booth_distance_m is ~615 m, +/-70 m.

lerdo-south-booths.title: Lerdo (Sur)
lerdo-south-booths.notes: Lerdo, booths in the foreground: cars drive toward the camera and stop at gates staffed by uniformed officers, so the booth end is the near end and the booth is in view (booth_distance_m 0), which makes this the one calibration whose wait does not depend on its unverified scale. Direction is INFERRED as southbound (Mexican customs on arrival in Juarez) from the officers and the flow toward the Juarez end; not confirmed, hence direction_verified false. Two lanes split at the orange divider; width assumed 7 m.
